newsitem.title: UK: UK's ECGD cover now available for Algeria.
newsitem.headline: UK's ECGD cover now available for Algeria.

text.p: Britain's Export Credit Guarantee Department (ECGD) said on Thursday it would make credit available for British companies competing for contracts in Algeria's oil and gas sector.

The ECGD said Algeria's "positive economic progress...under its IMF reform programme and a satisfactory performance under its debt rescheduling agreements with both the London and Paris Clubs" had prompted the move.
Cover will be offered only to projects where "ECGD can be satisfied that payment and physical security risks have been sufficiently mitigated", the ECGD said.
It also said cover would not be actually committed "until Algeria has achieved a four month good track record of servicing ECGD debt...and remained on track with its IMF reform programme".
ECGD cover for Algeria was originally withdrawn in November 1991 due to the high risk then of sovereign default.
